subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should the restart-drain bypass remain a core-internal mechanism, or is OpenClaw intentionally adding a public plugin SDK method that can enqueue during gateway draining?
rationale: The PR currently makes a security-sensitive restart-drain bypass visible on an exported plugin SDK type, and that API direction cannot be safely inferred from implementation code alone.

options.title: Keep Bypass Internal
options.body: Recommended: hide enqueueInternal and related drain context behind core-owned/internal helpers so public plugin code cannot bypass gateway draining.

options.title: Approve Public API
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly accept a public plugin SDK bypass, but it needs documented semantics, compatibility tests, and security-boundary review.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: If the branch remains too broad or dirty, pause it and land a narrower restart-drain repair on a clean branch.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Internal
